articles.summary: ("WhiteHorse Finance" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: WHF) announced that it will redeem its 7.875% Notes due 2028 (Nasdaq: WHFCL) (the "Notes"). The Company will redeem 100%, or $34,500,000 aggregate principal amount, of the issued and outstanding Notes on December 15, 2026 (the "Redemption Date"), following which the Notes will be delisted from the Nasdaq Global Select Market. The redemption price per Note will be $25 plus accrued and unpaid interest otherwise payable for the then-current quarterly interest period accrued to, but excluding, the Redemption Date. The regular quarterly interest installment due on December 15, 2026 will be paid separately to holders of record at the close of business on December 1, 2026, in accordance with the indenture governing the Notes, and will not also be paid as part of the principal redemption payment. articles.summary: ("WhiteHorse Finance" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: WHF) today announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. In addition, the Company's board of directors has declared a distribution of $0.25 per share with respect to the quarter ending December 31, 2026. The distribution will be payable on January 6, 2027 to stockholders of record as of December 21, 2026. Stuart Aronson, WhiteHorse Finance's Chief Executive Officer, commented, "During the third quarter, we continued to execute on the priorities we have previously outlined, including actively managing restructured and underperforming credits and maintaining discipline in new originations. Net asset value per share increased for a second consecutive quarter, driven by favorable portfolio markups. Non-accruals declined following the completion of a restructuring, and there were no new additions to non-accrual during the quarter.
